text: Built-in AI assistant can read threads, write drafts, search entire email history, and check your calendar
quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more

text: AI web browsing is enabled by default for paid plans
quote: AI web browsing enabled by default: Now automatically on for paid plans

text: You can connect almost any app to the AI via a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
quote: You can connect virtually any application through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Just click "Add custom integration" and point to an MCP server of your choice — or even create your own.

text: AI Assistant integrations let it complete complex workflows across business apps without leaving the inbox
quote: connects our AI Assistant to all your business applications, letting you accomplish complex workflows without ever leaving your inbox

text: AI Snippets let you define a reusable email template once and reuse it later
quote: AI Snippets let you define an email template once upfront and then re-use it whenever you need it.

text: AI Snippets can be shared and reused across an entire team, not just individually
quote: AI Snippets are available both for individual use and for use across your team.

text: Scheduled send lets you write a message now and have it sent automatically at a future time
quote: Scheduled send gives you the ability to send an email at a future time.

text: Undo send lets you revert an already-sent message back into an editable draft
quote: Undo send staves off the panic you feel when you accidentally send a message that wasn't ready by allowing you to revert a sent message back to a draft.

text: Splits divide one big inbox into multiple focused inboxes, each shown in its own tab
quote: They’re a simple way to divide your one big inbox into multiple smaller, more focused inboxes – each in its own tab.

text: Team comments let you privately discuss an email with teammates directly inside the app
quote: Team comments let you privately discuss an email with your team directly in Shortwave, so you can plan how to respond together

text: @mentioning a teammate in a comment gives them access to both the comment and the underlying email
quote: Something special happens when you `@mention` a teammate in a comment – they suddenly get access to not just your comment, but the email too

text: AI shows inline autocomplete suggestions while you draft an email; press tab to accept
quote: you’ll see suggestions presented to you automatically as you draft emails. Just press ‘tab’ to complete.

text: Instant Summaries automatically appear at the top of an email thread as soon as you open it
quote: Instant Summaries show up at the very top of your email threads the instant you open them.

text: Custom AI filters let you write plain-English scripts to auto-label, star, or archive emails
quote: Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.

text: A built-in GitHub integration lets the AI check repositories and manage issues
quote: GitHub: Check repositories and manage issues

text: A Zapier integration connects the AI to thousands of other third-party services

text: One click identifies important emails and todos, letting you sweep away the rest in bulk
